spans.s:
m. (-त्सः)
A fountain, a spring.
E.
उन्द to wet, and स Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ङ्गः)
1 The haunch or part above the hip.
2 The acclivity or slope of a hill.
3 Association, union.
4

Embrace.
5

The bottom or deep part of an ulcer.
E.
उत्, षञ्ज to embrace, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Associated, combined, joined.
E.
उत् षञ्ज before to be joined with, क्त aff.

mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिनी-ङ्गि)
Associating or combining with, an associate, a partner.
m. (-ङ्गी)
An ulcer, a deep sore.
f. (-ङ्गिनी)
Pimples on the inner edge of the eyelids.
E.
उत्युङ्ग and इनि aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
1 Destroyed. overturned.
2 Decayed, in ruins.
3 Risen, increased.
E.
उत् before षद to go, affix क्त.

m. (-र्गः)
1 Abandoning, quitting.
2 Resigning, retiring from.
3 Giving, donation.
4 Any precept or rule.
5 Presentation of any thing promised to a god or Brahman, with suitable ceremonies.
6 A particular ceremony preparatory to a course of the

Vedas.
7

Dejection, excretion, voiding by stool, &c.
E.
उत् before सृज to quit, to leave, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Gift, donation.
2 Abandoning, leaving, &c.
E.
उत् before सृज to leave, and ल्युट् affix: see the preceding.

f. (-णी)
A Jaina division of time, a long period described as 10 crores of crores of oceans of years; this period alternates with one of similar duration: see अवसर्पिणी.
E.
उत् much, सृप to go, णिनि and ङीष् affs.

m. (-र्प्पः)
1 Going or gliding upwards.
2 Swelling, heaving.
E.
उत् before सृप to go, घञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Gliding upward.
2 Swelling, heaving.
E.
उत् before सृप to go gently, ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Heaving, heaved, undulating.
2 Gliding or going upwards.
E.
उत् before सृप to go, क्त aff.

mfn. (-र्प्पी-र्प्पिणी-र्प्पि)
1 What glides upwards.
2 Rising gently, heaving, &c.
E.
उत्सर्प्प and इनि aff.

f. (-र्य्या)
A cow fit to take the bull.
E.
उत्, सृ to go, and ण्यत् aff.

m. (-वः)
1 A festival, a jubilee.
2 Height, elevation.
3

Impatience.
4

Wish.
5

Passion, wrath.
E.
उत्, षू to bear, to bring forth, affix अच्; happiness, &c. is produced by it.

n. (-नं)
1 Going up, ascending, rising.
2 Raising, elevating.
3 Destroying, overturning.
4 Cleaning the person with perfumes.
5 Rubbing or chafing the limbs.
6 Ploughing a field twice or thoroughly.
7 Healing a sore, causing it to fill up.
E.
उत् much, षद to destroy, in the causal form, affix ल्युट्.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be gone up or ascended.
2 To be effected.
3 To be destroyed.
n. (-यं)
Any application to a sore producing granulations.
E.
उत् before षद to go, causal form, affix अनीयर्; also उत्सादितव्य and उत्साद्य.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Risen, ascended.
2 Raised, elevated.
3

Destroyed.
4

Cleansed, purified with oil, perfumes, &c.
E.
as above, affix क्त.

m. (-कः)
1 A doorkeeper, a porter.
2 A guard, a guardian.
E.
उत्, सृ to go, in the causal, and वुन् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Removing, keeping at a distance.
2 Moving, causing to move.
E.
उत्, सृ to go, causal form, ल्युट् aff.

m. (-हः)
1 Effort, perseverance, strenuous and continued exertion.
2 A thread.
3

Happiness.
4

Firmness, fortitude.
E.
उत् much, सह to bear, to be able, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
Active, energetic, persevering.
E.
उत्साह and वतुप् aff.

n. (-नं)
Heroism.
E.
उत्साह exertion, and वर्द्धन increasing, from वृध and ल्युट् aff.

mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं)
Active, persevering.
E.
उत्साह and सम्पन्न effected.

mf. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
Active, persevering.
E.
उत्साह and इनि aff.

mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं)
1 Haughty, proud, rude.
2 Elevated, raised.
3 Enlarged, increased.
4

Sprinkled.
5

Disordered, disturbed (in mind, &c.)
m. (-क्तः)
A king's wrestler.
E.
उत्, षिच to sprinkle, and क्त aff.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
1 Augmenting, growing.
2 Sprinkling.
E.
उत्, षिच to sprinkle, शानच् aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
1 Zealously active, making exertions for a gratifying object.
2 Regretting, missing, sorrowing for.
3 Fond of, attached to.
E.
उत् much, सु to produce, क्विप् and कन् affs.

f. (-ता)
1 Sorrow, regret.
2 Attachment, affection.
E.
उत्सुक and तल् affix; also with त्व, affix उत्सुकत्वं.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्रा-त्रं)
1 Loose, detached, unstrung.
2 Irregular, out of rule.
E.
उत् before सूत्र a thread, &c.

m. (-रः)
Evening, twilight.
E.
उत् priv. सूर the sun; sunset.

ind.
Having quitted.
E.
उत् before सृज to leave, ल्यप् aff.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Left, abandoned.
2 Given, presented.
3 Cast into or upon.
E.
उत् and सृज to leave, affix क्त, deriv. irr.

m. (-शुः)
A bull set at liberty upon particular occasions, as a marriage, &c. and allowed to go about at will.
E.
उत्सृष्ट loosed, and पशु an animal.

m. (-कः)
1 Increase, enlargement.
2 Pride, haughtiness.
3 Casting water, &c. on any thing, sprinkling.
4 Flying out or up, foaming or spouting over, showering.
E.
उत् on, षिच् to sprinkle, घञ् aff.

n. (-नं)
1 Showering or spouting upwards.
2 Boiling or foaming over.
E.
उत् and सेचन sprinkling.

m. (-धः)
1 Height, elevation.
2 The body.
3 Fatness, obesity.
4

Intumescence.
5

Thickness.
n. (-धं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
उत् up, षिध to go, affix घञ्.

m. (-यः)
A smile.
E.
उत् and स्मय a smile.
